feeds.title: Capozzi Design Build Blog
feeds.description: Capozzi Design Build revolutionizes lives through home transformation. With visionary design and full-service capabilities, they craft bespoke spaces, elevating Northeast Ohioan lifestyles. From concept to completion, they ensure excellence in every aspect, making the journey exceptional.

feeds.title: Studio J Blog
feeds.description: Studio J stands as Central Ohio's premier home furnishings provider, boasting exquisite furniture and top-tier interior design services. With a curated selection of fine furniture and expert guidance from their design team, clients can elevate their spaces with ease. Explore their insightful interior design blogs and diverse furniture offerings, including modular and custom options.

feeds.title: Crimson Design Group Blog
feeds.description: Founded by Cheryl Stauffer in 2003, Crimson Design Group thrives on collaborative synergy, crafting bespoke spaces that resonate with clients' narratives. Their process blends creativity with structure, delivering unique and award-winning designs that seamlessly merge artistry with functionality. With a commitment to high-touch service and creative excellence, Crimson Design Group ensures an unparalleled experience from conception to completion.

feeds.title: BREPURPOSED Blog
feeds.description: Embark on a journey of inspiration with Brepurposed, the blog curated by Bre, an interior decorator and DIY enthusiast. Discover articles on home decor, DIY crafts, recipes, and engaging interior design challenges. Bre's passion for evolving home decor encourages readers to explore new styles and embrace creativity. Join her to uncover your unique design aesthetic and unleash your inner decorator.

feeds.title: G. Everett Blog
feeds.description: G. Everett, a premier interior design studio in Columbus, Ohio, offers full-service solutions for residential, commercial, and professional spaces. Their passion lies in crafting narratives through design, ensuring spaces reflect clients' stories and needs. With a blend of creativity and analytical prowess, their team brings visions to life with unmatched expertise and precision.

feeds.title: Odell Construction Blog
feeds.description: Founded by Justin with a vision for unique, functional homes, Odell Construction renovates with a mission to enhance lives through collaboration. Their commitment to thoughtful work resonates in every detail, ensuring clients experience joy and relief in their newly transformed spaces.

feeds.title: Sacksteder's Interiors Blog
feeds.description: Explore Sacksteder's Interiors Blog, where beautiful retail spaces showcase premier accessories, floral designs, and furniture. Discover expert tips and tricks on decorating living spaces, alongside the latest design news and ideas. Dive into a world of interior design inspiration with Sacksteder's.

feeds.title: S. Flynn Design Blog
feeds.description: Meet Kyle and Sadie Beachy, the dynamic duo behind S. Flynn Design Blog. They prioritize client satisfaction, acting as stewards of time, money, and space. With a focus on creating a positive custom home-building experience, their blog offers valuable insights and inspiration for your home projects.

feeds.title: Amy Youngblood
feeds.description: Amy Youngblood Interiors, a certified Women's Business Enterprise, is led by Amy, a seasoned designer with over 20 years of experience. Recognized as one of Ohio's top designers, her fusion of artistic talent and business acumen has garnered acclaim. Known for clean-lined, sophisticated designs, Amy's work graces both local and national media, setting a standard of excellence in interior design.

feeds.title: Ingrid Porter Interiors Blog
feeds.description: Ingrid Porter, the acclaimed Cleveland interior designer from Chagrin Falls, Ohio, excels in crafting spaces that embody personal style and enhance lifestyles. Her firm, Ingrid Porter Interiors, specializes in intricate and tailored design projects across Northeastern Ohio, reflecting years of expertise and dedication to fulfilling each client's unique vision for their home.

feeds.title: East and Gray Interiors Blog
feeds.description: East and Gray Interiors, led by Andrea Durcik, a multifaceted interior designer, global explorer, and conservation advocate, crafts narratives of life through eco-conscious design. With a focus on individuality and sustainability, the firm orchestrates homes that echo clients' histories and values, making conscientious choices for a better world. Explore their inspiring blog merging design, travel, and sustainable living.

feeds.title: Laura of Pembroke Blog » Interior Design
feeds.description: Laura of Pembroke, a cherished family-owned retail gem with a European flair, offers chic women's apparel, home décor, and gifts. Founded in 1987 by Laura Sirpilla Bosworth, Veronica Sirpilla, and John B. Sirpilla, it began as a women's clothing boutique in Cleveland, later expanding to Canton. With Susan and Johnny Sirpilla onboard, it evolved into a comprehensive lifestyle destination, including interior design services and nationwide shipping. Stay updated on Canton and Cleveland locations for exclusive offers and events.

feeds.title: Snazzy Little Things Blog
feeds.description: Explore Snazzy Little Things Blog, a haven for budget-friendly DIY enthusiasts seeking easy, quick tutorials for home decoration and improvement. From decorating ideas to DIY projects, discover accessible techniques to enhance your home's beauty on any budget.

feeds.title: Hackett House Studio Blog
feeds.description: Erin, a former financial advisor turned interior designer, founded Hackett House Studio to infuse happiness and storytelling into spaces. With a modern yet timeless aesthetic, she prioritizes functionality alongside form, promoting beauty and wellness. Her financial background ensures professionalism and budget consciousness, while her emphasis on transparency and organization guarantees a seamless project experience and a proud investment.

feeds.title: Kerry Dorsey Moylan Design Blog
feeds.description: Kerry Dorsey Moylan Design Blog offers diverse interior design series, blending personal anecdotes with expert advice. Kerry, a lifelong design enthusiast, believes in homes as nurturing spaces. Her eclectic style combines antiques, flea market treasures, and blue-and-white accents, creating welcoming environments that feel like an extension of oneself.

feeds.title: Hill's Interiors Blog
feeds.description: At Hill's Interiors, every customer is guaranteed exceptional service from knowledgeable staff and veteran installers. Whether for homes, businesses, or new constructions, their team ensures the best investment decisions. Offering a wide range of products, they are Norwalk, Ohio's go-to for flooring, interior design, and home improvement needs.

feeds.title: Refresh Home Design Blog
feeds.description: Meet Michelle Santhanam, owner of Refresh Home Design. She believes in homes as personal expressions, rejecting one-size-fits-all designs. Michelle aims to refresh environments and lives, weaving past and future into unique, cherished spaces. With her, expect originality, inspiration, and fearless expression in every design.

feeds.title: Reverie Home Co
feeds.description: Reverie Home Co, a boutique interior design firm, offers curated home goods and vintage collections. Their lifestyle blog, Project on Main, provides insights into Ohio's interior design scene. Experience their unique blend of design expertise and curated offerings.

feeds.title: Ohio Desk Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 1908 as Ohio Desk and Chair Company, Ohio Desk has evolved into a comprehensive provider of integrated interiors and technology products. With a rich history spanning over a century, they now serve markets beyond Cleveland, offering a wide range of solutions for modern workspaces.

feeds.title: Peony + Honey Blog
feeds.description: Meet Erika, the creative force behind the Peony and Honey Blog. Transitioning from radio and TV hosting in Cleveland, she's now a full-time content creator, sharing DIY projects and home decor ideas. Collaborating with top brands, Erika connects with her online community, affectionately known as her Honeys, to inspire and entertain with her creativity.

feeds.title: Jackie Barnes Design Blog
feeds.description: Jackie Barnes Design customizes everlasting homes for busy individuals and families, creating spaces that seamlessly integrate with their lives, fostering profound connections and enriching experiences. Their ethos emphasizes that a home transcends mere living quarters, serving as a reflection of one's quality of life. Through mindful design, they pave the way for homes that endure across generations. Explore their comprehensive interior design resources for your next project.

feeds.title: Budget Dumpster » Home Improvement & DIY
feeds.description: Discover comprehensive guides on home remodelling, eco-friendly living, and DIY tips. Stay updated with the latest articles on DIY and home improvement. Budget Dumpster offers nationwide low-cost waste removal solutions, prioritizing service excellence.

feeds.title: Designed Decor Blog
feeds.description: Explore Designed Decor Blog, curated by Dede, a versatile entrepreneur passionate about DIY, furniture decoration, and Airbnb hosting. Delve into a world of thrifty home transformation, where each project brings joy and style on a budget. Join Dede to craft a home you adore, one DIY at a time.
